reason: My admin already types the receipts into Excel every week. It's behind, but it gets done and my partner gets the numbers, so I don't see why I'd pay $19 a month for the same thing.
objection: This is work I'm already paying a salary for. I'd also have to move us from our Excel file to a Google Sheet and trust a bot to read handwritten nota properly, and I'm not convinced it saves enough to be worth it.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 40 documents caught duplicates or mistakes my admin missed, or my admin told me it saved her real hours each week, I would try the $19 plan.
